model-new-book.code:
model NewBook
  @minLength(1) title: string
  author: string
  year: int

model-book-changes.code:
model BookChanges
  title?: string
  year?: int
  available?: boolean

entity-loan.code:
@entity("loans")
entity Loan
  @primary(generated = true)
  id: int
  bookId: int
  reader: string
  returned: boolean = false

repo-by-author.code:
repository BookRepository
  byAuthor(author: string) Book[]
    where({ "author": author })
    orderBy("year")
    getMany()

repo-available-since.code:
repository BookRepository
  availableSince(year: int, max: int = 20) Book[]
    where({ "available": true, "year": gte(year) })
    orderBy("title")
    limit(max)
    getMany()

repo-by-title.code:
repository BookRepository
  byTitle(title: string) Result<Error, Book>
    where({ "title": title })
    getOne()

repo-count-open-loans.code:
repository LoanRepository
  openFor(reader: string) int
    where({ "reader": reader, "returned": false })
    count()

usecase-create-book.code:
usecase CreateBook(books: BookRepository)
  exec(input: NewBook) Result<Error, Book>
    taken = ~books.where({ "title": input.title }).exists()
    if taken
      return Err(Conflict("${input.title} already exists"))
    book = ~books.save(Book(title = input.title, author = input.author, year = input.year))
    Ok(book)

usecase-get-book.code:
usecase GetBook(books: BookRepository)
  exec(id: int) Result<Error, Book>
    ~books.find(id)

usecase-lend-book.code:
usecase LendBook(books: BookRepository, loans: LoanRepository)
  exec(bookId: int, reader: string) Result<Error, Loan>
    book = ~books.find(bookId)
    if not book
      return Err(NotFound("book ${bookId} not found"))
    if not book.available
      return Err(Conflict("book ${bookId} is not available"))
    book.available = false
    ~books.save(book)
    loan = Loan(bookId = bookId, reader = reader, returned = false)
    ~loans.save(loan)
    Ok(loan)

usecase-books-of-author.code:
usecase BooksOfAuthor(books: BookRepository)
  exec(author: string) Result<Error, Book[]>
    if author.length == 0
      Err(Invalid("author is empty"))
    else
      Ok(~books.byAuthor(author))

appcomponent-books.code:
appcomponent BooksAppComponent
  book() = GetBook.exec
  create() = CreateBook.exec
  byAuthor() = BooksOfAuthor.exec

appcomponent-loans.code:
appcomponent LoansAppComponent
  lend() = LendBook.exec
  giveBack() = ReturnBook.exec

tools-books.code:
tools BookTools(books: BooksAppComponent)
  // Gives the title of the book with that id.
  bookTitle(id: int) string
    match ~books.book(id)
      Ok(b) -> b.title
      Err(e) -> e.message

tools-loans.code:
tools LoanTools(loans: LoansAppComponent)
  // Lends a book to a reader.
  lend(bookId: int, reader: string) string
    match ~loans.lend(bookId, reader)
      Ok(l) -> "loan ${l.id}"
      Err(e) -> e.message

agent-librarian.code:
agent Librarian(tools: BookTools)
  prompt: string = "You help readers find books. Use the tools; never invent ids."

agent-loans.code:
agent LoanDesk(tools: LoanTools)
  model: string = "coder"
  prompt: string = "You lend books. Confirm every loan."

tests-create-book.code:
tests Books
  books: BooksAppComponent = inject<BooksAppComponent>()

  @test("creates a book and refuses the same title")
  checkDuplicate() void
    book = NewBook(title = "Dune", author = "Herbert", year = 1965)
    first = ~books.create(book)
    expect(first.isOk)
    second = ~books.create(book)
    expect(second.error.status == 409)

tests-missing-book.code:
tests Missing
  books: BooksAppComponent = inject<BooksAppComponent>()

  @test("a missing book is 404")
  missingBook() void
    missing = ~books.book(999)
    expect(missing.isErr)
    expect(missing.error.status == 404)

service-isbn.code:
service Isbn()
  valid(code: string) boolean
    code.replaceAll("-", "").length == 13

function-label.code:
service Labels(year: int, now: int) string
  label = if now - year < 2
    "new"
  else if now - year < 10
    "recent"
  else
    "classic"
  label

flutter-screen.code:
@screen(route = "/books", providers = [BooksManager])
stateless BooksScreen
  build(context: BuildContext) Widget
    Scaffold(
      appBar = AppBar(title = Text("Books")),
      body = BooksStateBuilder<BooksManager>(
        loading = () => Center(child = CircularProgressIndicator()),
        loaded = (books) => ListView.builder(
          itemCount = books.length,
          itemBuilder = (context, index) => ListTile(title = Text(books[index].title)),
        ),
        error = (e) => Center(child = Text(e.message)),
      ),
    )

web-tile.code:
// A view BookTile(book: Book) of the web app: an li with class "tile" whose children are a span with class "title" showing the book's title and a small with its author.
stateless BookTile(book: Book)
  build() Element
    li(className = "tile", children = [
      span(className = "title", children = book.title),
      small(children = book.author),
    ])
